findings.title: LoyaltyController::check() has no UNIQUE-violation try/catch on inline loyalty_code mint
findings.severity_explained: md5(uniqid()) collision is astronomically rare (2^32 over uniqid hex), but two simultaneous /loyalty/check calls for distinct phone-only customers without loyalty_code could in theory mint the same 8-char prefix. There is no UNIQUE constraint visible on users.loyalty_code in the migrations grep, so a collision would silently overwrite. Same pattern at LoyaltyController::generateQr():799. Recommend either (a) adding UNIQUE(loyalty_code) on users with try/catch retry loop, or (b) at minimum doubling to 12-16 chars to push collision probability further into noise. Not a V1 blocker because traffic volume on single-resto Le Cayenne makes collision effectively impossible (and any caught collision would simply re-throw 500), but the code reads like it assumes uniqueness without enforcing it.
findings.remediation: Add `$table->unique('loyalty_code')` migration + wrap mint in retry-on-23000 loop. V1.0.2 backlog.

findings.title: Frontend /loyalty/redeem path can be bypassed by staff role to redeem ANY customer's points
findings.severity_explained: The frontend redeem endpoint allows isStaff (Admin / Branch Manager / POS Operator / Stuff) to redeem ANY loyalty_code's points without belonging to the staff member's branch. The §6.1 cashier permission gate (pos.redeem-loyalty) only protects the POS-side endpoint at PosLoyaltyController. The kiosk-side endpoint here uses hasAnyRole() which is global. In theory a compromised POS Operator account on branch=5 could redeem an admin-marked customer's balance via this frontend endpoint. Acceptable in V1 single-resto (no multi-tenant attack surface), but exposes a cross-branch hole when V2 SaaS lands. Note: this redeem path also writes order_id=null in the ledger row (line 315), making cross-correlation with the POS redeem audit trail impossible — partial double-spend window if both POS and frontend redeem fire same-second on same code.
findings.remediation: V1.0.2 — gate frontend /loyalty/redeem behind branch_id check OR remove staff-bypass from this endpoint entirely (force POS path).

findings.title: PosRedemptionService discount-vs-total math comment header non-canonical for 'COMPLETED' enum
findings.severity_explained: The LOCK §6.7 reference text mentions a 'COMPLETED' OrderStatus enum constant that does not exist. The implementation correctly uses DELIVERED/CANCELED/REJECTED/RETURNED as the terminal set (verified via PaymentStatus::PAID=5 + OrderStatus::DELIVERED=13 enums), so behaviour is sound. This is purely a documentation drift — the source-of-truth code is correct, but a future reader following the comment text could conclude there is a missing enum value. Cosmetic only.
findings.remediation: Update LOCK_POS_LOYALTY_REDEEM_UI_2026-05-18.md §6.7 wording to align with actual OrderStatus enum (or accept the in-code 'non-canonical' note at line 41 as the authoritative reconciliation). No code change needed.
